UserFavorites.title: UserFavorites
UserFavorites.description: Stores the user's favorited Anwaa star numbers (1 to 40).

favorites.description: Array of favorited star numbers (1..40), bounded to max 40 items.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

/users/{uid}.description: User document storing the user's favorite stars array.

/users/{uid}/favorites/{docId}.description: User favorites subcollection document storing the user's favorite stars array.
